text: Pella, 336 BC. Philip is dead and the phalanx roars your name. The empire of Persia waits across the sea — but first, Macedonia must answer to a twenty-year-old king.

choices.text: Cross the Hellespont and seek battle at the River Granicus
Ride east to Gordium, where a wagon waits with an impossible knot

text: The River Granicus runs fast and shallow. Memnon's cavalry waits on the far bank, spears glinting in the morning light.

choices.text: Charge the far bank at the head of the Companions
Send the phalanx across in column and grind them down

text: In Gordium, an old wagon is bound with cornel bark so tight no end can be seen. Whoever undoes the Gordian Knot, they say, will rule all of Asia.

choices.text: Cut the knot with a single stroke of your sword
Probe the weave as patiently as a shield wall holds
Leave the knot hanging and ride on
